text:
sam: FYI — seeing sustained quota spikes on hosted-east for /v1/generate. Thinking emergency tiebreaker: pin critical routes to Dedicated pool-A for the next 30m. Need quick toggle + rollback plan.

maya: do we have perf/cost estimate for pinning?

sam: rough numbers: +8-12ms p95, cost delta ~3-5% for the window, but keeps upstream errors at 0.

jorge: we should attach an explicit header so downstream can attribute: X-Redwood-Egress: dedicated-A. Also add a telemetry tag so dashboards filter by pinned=true.

tim: oncall here — prefer staged rollout. Start with 10% sessions pinned for 5m, check error-rate and latency traces, then 50% -> 100% if stable. If error-rate > 0.8% or latency spike > 20% rollback immediately.

sam: agreed. I'll prepare the toggle and a manual rollback command. Will also wire an alert to #oncall if the metric thresholds hit.

deploy-bot: pipeline triggered: emergency-egress-pin v1 -> staging -> canary. Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3421 :gear:

sam: toggle snippet (manual curl to put into console toggle endpoint):

```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/toggles/egress-pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"route_match":"/v1/generate","pin_to":"dedicated-A","percent":10,"meta":{"xheader":"X-Redwood-Egress:dedicated-A","reason":"incident-2485"}}'
```

maya: add TTL on the toggle so it auto-expires in 30m to avoid lingering pins.

jorge: +1 for TTL. Also add a post-change job to emit a one-off event: `telemetry.emit("egress.pin", {route:"/v1/generate",percent:10})` so dashboards populate immediately.

sam: plan written: 1) apply 10% pin with TTL=30m, header tag, and telemetry emit; 2) wait 5m, check dashboards (errors, p95, user-identified failed requests); 3) if OK -> 50% for 5m -> 100%; 4) if any threshold breach -> run rollback command below.

sam: rollback (manual):

```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/toggles/egress-pin/remove \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"route_match":"/v1/generate","pin_id":"incident-2485"}'
```

tim: I'll be watching the graphs and traces. Put me on the incident call for the decision point at 5m.

incident-bot: incident created: INC-2485 | Egress congestion on hosted-east. Severity: P2. Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-2485 :rotating_light:

maya: quick UX ask for console changes after this: add a toggle summary on the route page that shows active pins, TTL, and who initiated, so ops can triage without reading the incident thread.

jorge: noted — will prototype a tiny panel that lists active egress overrides and an emergency rollback button wired to the same API (with audit logs).

sam: executing step 1 now. Posting results in 2–3m. :rocket:

sam: step 1 applied: 10% pinned. telemetry event emitted. Dashboards show no immediate errors. Keeping watch.

tim: saw a small p95 bump but within tolerance. continuing.

sam: promoting to 50% now.

deploy-bot: canary log snippet: `pinned=50% route=/v1/generate ok=9983 err=17`

maya: good. if we hold at 50% for 5m and metrics stable, promote to 100% then set TTL to expire in 30m post-full.

sam: promoted to 100%. TTL set to 30m from now. Monitoring.

jorge: filing a follow-up task to add a telemetry tag column on the routing dashboard so we can filter pinned sessions by origin/tenant.

tim: leaving post-incident notes: we should add a health-check for egress pool saturation and alert earlier to avoid emergency pins.

sam: agreed. closing loop once incident doc written. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
